folds.heading: ## Full-content map reconciliation, 2026-11-04 (B180)
folds.body:
The complete original assessment, same-day updates, F1–F5/D1/O1–O3/C1–C5 and P1–P5 were read. The48-row visualization remains a document-label snapshot, with23/5/4/16 categories, not player-value/effort weights or current gameplay verdicts.646historical vision rows versus560classified rows leaves86other/superseded/preferences, not an implied86missing features or a completion percentage. Filename counts and bounded no-import results do not establish absent worlds or consumers. The same document’s later pack-registry and source/gameplay-writer qualification supersedes its original no-pack-save observation. No replacement serializer is selected.

The foundation conversation and retained-place slices were selected and integrated at their separately recorded scope, not left as unselected P4 proposals. The later [method-use checkpoint](../gm/dispatch/foundation-method-use-2026-11-04/CHECKPOINT.md), read fully in B153, records released M21/M22/M25 work,69distinct scoped tests and33browser assertions on its final fixture/input. Earlier “active method-use” wording in this map is historical. Preserve actual learned/seen distinctions, faculty/energy/carrier differences, recipient disclosure and native physical paper requirements; the named fixture does not establish all source-arrival, old-save migration, arbitrary divination or every activity. No current reexecution or renewed native proof follows the receipt.

The ten capability families and C1–C5 remain useful dependency/trigger questions, not ten mandatory new modules or a cosmology-first gate. Source-defined world laws, actual carrier/support/custody, independent knowledge/history, clear desktop consequence and current persistence govern selected uses. Current AD51 permits shared design with the first real consumer and later different-case validation; it is not a requirement to implement a second full world before designing a seam. Current lead/Klein-first with Harry alongside and Frontier/Mistglass test-bed scope govern sequence. No visualization/browser rerun, runtime work, installed-app or release state was verified here.
